findings.description: The call to extract_zipped_paths on DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH was removed, so the default CA bundle path is used as-is.
findings.rationale: Trigger: requests is run from a zip archive (zipapp or zipimport) and certs.where() returns a path inside the zip. os.path.exists on that path is False, so an OSError about an invalid CA bundle is raised and every default HTTPS verification fails. The new comment says certifi extracts the file, but that is only true if certs.where() uses certifi's as_file/extraction, which this diff does not show.
